issue.body:
Part of #625. Depends on the V3-H.1 command denominator mapping.

## Outcome

Implement and test authenticated v3 GitHub, PR-state, review-publication linkage, and PR creation/update/readback routes under one `csdlc` binary.

## Command routes

- `csdlc github`
- `csdlc github-issue`
- `csdlc github-pr`
- `csdlc pr-state`
- `csdlc publish`
- `csdlc review`

## Acceptance criteria

- v3 records exact-head review assignment and review result with self-review protection.
- v3 publication refuses missing/stale review truth.
- PR creation/update visibly includes `Closes #xxx` when closing linkage is intended.
- PR state readback authenticates live GitHub state instead of trusting caller-supplied strings.
- Tests cover closing-vs-part-of linkage, stale PR event recovery, raw-credential redaction, caller-forged readback rejection, and review-authority denial.
- A real issue canary reaches an open PR through v3.
- No raw `gh` lifecycle writes and no v2 operational fallback.
- No v2 source changes.

## Non-goals

- No merge, finish, cleanup, or cutover in this issue.
- Do not merge or close #505.
